Here's to a lovely Thursday morning: ☕ ☕ It's **Swin** , again. Last month, we
[told you how the Pentagon](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-iran-war-pentagon-good-
news) has been put under a shocking amount of pressure by the White House and
by higher-ups at the **Pete Hegseth** -fronted Defense Department to
essentially cook its own Iran war data and [twist its own
intel](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-iran-war-pentagon-good-news) before it is
presented to **Donald Trump**. Because why hurt the [Mad
King](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-one-year-america-first-mad-king) president's
feelings with numbers that show he's losing his illegal war?

In today's '**First Draft** ,' we take a look at _other_ parts of the U.S.
government that Trump and his White House are coaxing with a very simple
message: the boss will be monumentally livid at you if you don't get very
serious - very soon - about jailing his political enemies. Elsewhere,
**Rashida Tlaib 's** Lebanon war powers push infuriates Republicans while a
senior Democrat warns about **Bill Pulte 's** election danger.

Two months ago, Donald Trump fired then-Attorney General Pam Bondi, because
she wasn't corrupt or zealously authoritarian
_[enough](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-fires-pam-bondi-justice-department)_[for
his liking](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-fires-pam-bondi-justice-department).
With her fall rose the acting AG, Todd Blanche, yet another of Trump's former
personal lawyers turned federalized hatchetmen. Off the bat, the Trump White
House, including the president himself, made something clear to Blanche in
private discussions, according to people familiar with the matter.
